title: Make devotion bear its own weight
summary: Naam and conduct are not separate rooms; the tongue that remembers must not leave the hands untouched.
takeaway: Make the mouth and hands carry the same devotion.
lifeApplication: Before posting, promising, or advising, pause at the mouth and hands together. Choose an action that can honor the sacred words you want to say.

source.shortMeaning: Naam asks devotion to become clean conduct, not only sacred speech.
source.lifeApplication: Before speaking devotion, choose the action that can bear it without contradiction.

evidence.coreClaim: Naam asks devotion to become clean conduct, not only sacred speech.
evidence.turn: The shabad refuses to separate remembrance from the way a person actually behaves.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before posting, promising, or advising, pause at the mouth and hands together. Choose an action that can honor the sacred words you want to say.
